market_summary: During the mid-London session, all six tracked assets are exhibiting range-bound consolidation characterized by contracting or stabilizing volatility and sub-1.0 RVOL. Major FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) are hovering directly above well-tested multi-touch session low supports, but lack the breakout volume required to justify shorting into support. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and US100 are oscillating tightly around their respective session Points of Control (POC) inside their value areas. BTCUSD is digesting its rebound from session lows between EMA20 and session VWAP. With no high-volume catalysts or clean structural breaks prior to the London-NY overlap, disciplined capital preservation warrants a HOLD across the board.
